title: U-Nesting 2D Solve Response
description: Wire response schema for solve_2d (SolveResponse). The 3D response (Pack3DResponse) is structurally similar but uses bins_used instead of sheets_used and each placement carries z and an orientation label.

placements.description: Instance-level placements for successfully placed geometry instances

total_requested.description: Total number of geometry INSTANCES requested (sum of every geometry's quantity). 'placements' is instance-level while 'unplaced' is deduplicated to unique geometry IDs, so the instance-level unplaced count is total_requested - placements.length. 0 on error responses.

unplaced.description: Deduplicated unique IDs of geometries that could not be fully placed (NOT per-instance)

Placement.description: Placement of a single geometry instance

instance.description: Instance index (0-based, for geometries with quantity > 1)

sheet_index.description: Index of the sheet/bin this instance is placed on
